items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training. (Required)
Experience coordinating HR activities, purchasing/reimbursements, finance and/or operations.
Experience working in a research environment.
Experience coordinating HR activities, purchasing/reimbursements, finance and/or operations within higher education institution(s).

The Lab Coordinator of the Pandemic & Epidemic Threat Analysis Lab (PETAL) in the School of Public Health provides administrative support to a computational infectious-disease modelling group (currently at five people and growing to around 10). The main priorities sit across the administrative areas of HR, finance, purchasing/reimbursements, and operations.
Proficient in communicating clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, and in integrating information in the completion of assignments.
Working knowledge of and/or ability to learn UC Berkeley systems, such as BearBuy, BFS, the reimbursement system, CalAnswers, HR Service Hub, UCPath, etc.
Proven ability to organize work functions in an efficient and effective manner.
Strong customer service orientation, including excellent interpersonal skills to be able to work with a wide range of faculty, researchers, staff, and students.
Ability to use sound judgment in responding to issues and concerns.
Ability in problem identification and reasoning; ability to develop original ideas to solve problems.
Ability to work effectively both independently and in collaboration with team members.
Thorough knowledge of common computer applications and web-based collaboration tools; ability to learn new technological platforms.
